|game_text=During your turn, target opponent's spy at a site you control; target is lost. (Immune to Droid Shutdown.) [Immune to Sense.] OR Cancel Dodge, I Think I Can Handle Myself, or a Force drain initiated by a lone Falcon. OR Target a starship weapon; it may not fire this turn.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[ComScan Detection (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

(Immune to Droid Shutdown.) [Immune to Sense.] OR Cancel Dodge, I Think I Can Handle Myself, or a Force drain initiated by a lone Falcon. OR Target a starship weapon; it may not fire this turn.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[ComScan Detection (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (PDF, 8 pages, footer “”; file created 17 June 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 21]] (18 June 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, page 3, file created 17 June 2023: “During your turn, target opponent's spy at a site you control; target is lost. (Immune to Droid Shutdown.) [Immune to Sense.] OR Cancel Dodge, I Think I Can Handle Myself, or a Force drain initiated by a lone Falcon. OR Target a starship weapon; it may not fire this turn.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[ComScan Detection (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “ComScan Detection”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[ComScan Detection (V)]] (published 18 June 2023) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[ComScan Detection]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The PDF was created on 17 June 2023, the day before the set's release (18 June 2023); the sheet was published with the set, so the slip is placed after the card image in place at release. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
